verdict.info: He may be carrying a 3lb penalty but \bNIGHT RAIDER\p is enjoying an excellent season and this speedy track should play to his strengths. He's the selection ahead of \bJakajaro\p, who should also be seen to good effect on this downhill course. Glorious Goodwood brings out the best in \bJm Jungle\p and he is next on the list ahead of \bRumstar\p.[Ben Hutton]

horses.comment: Reappeared with good second to Night Raider in the Group 3 Palace House at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) and bounced back from below-par run at Royal Ascot to win at Sandown (5f, good) four weeks ago, taking that Group 3 for the second year in a row; has won here and is firmly in calculations.
